name: Add bottom close button to info modals
description: **Summary.** Info modals (Modals that only show information and offer no action of their own) can only be closed with `esc`, or with the small `✕` in the top edge, which is easy to miss. Add a clickable **Close** button at the bottom of these Modals. **Context.** The attached screenshot is the Software Factory Factory setup screen (`src/plugins/software-factory/FactorySetupScreen.tsx`) after it ran, opened from Data Root onboarding; its only key hint is `esc back`. Router screens are drawn in a generic `Modal` by `src/tui/shell/Shell.tsx` (route stack, about line 452), where `modalHints` adds `esc back`. `src/tui/components/ModalFrame.tsx` draws the frame, the `✕` (`CloseButton`, only when `onClose` is set and the Modal is on top) and the `KeyHints` strip under a `border` rule; key hints are not clickable. `src/tui/components/Button.tsx` (label, `keyName` key cap, hover, click) should be reused. **Requirements.** (1) An info modal is the top Modal, with `onClose` set, whose footer keys are only the `esc` hint: no other key, no Form or ConfirmDialog inside. Examples: Factory setup after it ran, the Keys (help) Modal, any Plugin screen in that state. (2) An info modal shows a `Close` Button with the `esc` key cap in place of the hint strip, on the same line under the rule, so the Modal keeps its height. A click calls `onClose`, like `esc` and `✕`. (3) Implement it once in `ModalFrame`, so every core and Plugin info modal gets it; Modals with other keys (Forms, pickers, ConfirmDialog, Factory setup before it runs) keep their hint strip unchanged. (4) Under another layer (a nested Modal or a ContextMenu) the line goes quiet like the strip today: it keeps its line and width and ignores clicks. (5) The `✕` in the top edge stays. (6) Follow the TUI design system (`.agents/skills/rowbly-tui-design`): Button tokens, no frame of its own. **Out of scope.** Clickable buttons in ConfirmDialog or Forms; screen Modals (Story, Settings). **Docs.** Update `.agents/skills/rowbly-tui-design/components/Modal.md` and the Modals section of its `SKILL.md`, and mention the Close button in `docs/user-guide.md`. No new tests (AGENTS.md: UI, keys and layout need none); verify with agentic-tui screenshots (rowbly-screenshots skill). **Acceptance criteria.** Factory setup after it ran shows a clickable Close at the bottom that closes the screen as `esc` does; the Keys (help) Modal shows Close and a click closes it; a Form Modal (for example New Story) and a ConfirmDialog show no Close button and keep their hints; `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test:unit` and `pnpm test:cli` pass.
